verdict.rationale: Discord's first-party blog documents Threads as a way to branch a side conversation off a channel's main feed while keeping it in the channel, and says Private Threads have rolled out to all servers on desktop and mobile. That covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that a thread is anchored to a specific originating message, detail on admin or team-admin thread management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can reply in threads so side discussions stay attached to the original message

citations.quote: A Thread is a quick way to branch a conversation off of a channel’s main feed without removing it from the channel itself.
Private Threads are now available for all servers! This exciting update is rolling out to both desktop and mobile users now.
